title: Atomic All-or-Nothing Seat Hold
instructions: Implement `init_inventory`, `hold_seats` and `seat_states` in `seat_holds.py` with `sqlite3` and a database file, opening one connection per call. The hold must be all-or-nothing and race-safe: `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` plus a single compare-and-set `UPDATE` that only touches `AVAILABLE` seats, then compare the row count with the distinct seats requested.

evidence.label: Blocks the requested seats for the user and leaves others available
Rolls back completely when any requested seat is already held
Treats a seat that does not exist as unavailable, changing nothing
Counts duplicate ids once and raises ValueError for an empty request
init_inventory can be re-run without resetting held seats
Exactly one of 16 competing connections wins the same seats
Overlapping concurrent holds never give one seat to two users
Scopes holds to a single show
A held seat is unavailable even to the same user
A failed hold rolls back and closes its connection, releasing the lock
